manifest.observable: in-track component of the position difference between an element set and its successor, both propagated to the pass midpoint, km. No model is fitted.

attainability_floor.note: The abstention floor is an ATTAINABILITY precondition, not a power one: below it the nominal level cannot be reached by any permutation reference. The paper previously mislabelled it.

multiplicity.note: Eleven per-object tests plus three pooled. One halt is at chance level under the global null, so the single halt in analyses A-C is not evidence of dependence and the paper must not present it as such.
